title: Two Sisters on Wooden Swings, Suburban Lawn - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square-format snapshot with deckled edges depicting two young girls playing on wooden swings in a suburban backyard. The younger toddler sits on the left swing wearing a patterned summer sunsuit and soft white shoes, looking directly toward the camera with a curious expression. To the right, an older girl with dark braided pigtails wears shorts, a printed graphic t-shirt, socks, and sneakers while balancing on her swing. In the background stands a chain-link fence, dappled tree shade, and a neighboring house. The front edge is stamped with the processing month 'MAY •'.
